NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
BeModelCarePlan BaseBeModelCarePlan
BeModelCarePlan.identifier 1..*IdentifierIdentifiers assigned to this care plan
BeModelCarePlan.title 0..1stringTitle of the care plan
BeModelCarePlan.category 0..1CodeableConceptType of plan
Binding: CarePlanCategory (extensible)
BeModelCarePlan.basedOn 0..*Reference()Care plans that this care plan is based on
BeModelCarePlan.partOf 0..1Reference()The parent CareSet this CareSet is part of
BeModelCarePlan.status 1..1codestatus of the care plan
Binding: RequestStatus (required)
BeModelCarePlan.description 0..1stringDescription of the care plan
BeModelCarePlan.patient 1..1Reference()The person who is the subject of the care referenced in this CareSet
BeModelCarePlan.period 0..1PeriodTime period plan covers
BeModelCarePlan.author 1..1Reference()Who is responsible for plan
BeModelCarePlan.careTeam 0..*Reference()Care team assigned to the care plan
BeModelCarePlan.goal 0..*Reference()Expressed goals that this care plan is intended to achieve
BeModelCarePlan.note 0..*AnnotationComments about the care plan
BeModelCarePlan.intent 1..1codeIntent of the care plan
Binding: CarePlanIntent (required)
BeModelCarePlan.recordedDate 1..1dateTimeRecording date by the author or recorder (date of last update)
BeModelCarePlan.created 0..1dateTimeMoment the CareSet was created
BeModelCarePlan.activity 0..*Reference()Actions planned or performed within this CareSet
BeModelCarePlan.addresses 0..*Reference()The condition/problem for which this CareSet was set up
BeModelCarePlan.encounter 0..1Reference()The encounter referencing this CareSet
BeModelCarePlan.replaces 0..*Reference()The previous version of the care plan that this one replaces
BeModelCarePlan.contributor 0..*Reference()The person who adds content to the care plan
